mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interactions (user_id, target_type, target_id, interaction_type, metadata, cru, crd, luu, lud) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{favorite}, #{metadataJson}, #{cru}, NOW(3), #{luu}, NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE metadata = VALUES(metadata), luu = VALUES(luu), lud = VALUES(lud)
mapper.select: SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) as likeCount FROM interactions WHERE target_type = 'review' AND interaction_type = 'like' GROUP BY target_id
SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) as usefulCount FROM interactions WHERE target_type = 'review' AND interaction_type = 'useful' GROUP BY target_id
SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) as likeCount FROM interactions WHERE target_type = 'reply' AND interaction_type = 'like' GROUP BY target_id
